species.name: Capybara
mustRead: blunt squared-off brick-shaped head
no visible tail
barrel body on short partly webbed legs
species.note: Eyes, ears and nostrils sit high on the head; the rump is higher than the shoulders.

species.name: Fishing Cat
mustRead: stocky heavy-boned cat body
olive coat with rows of solid dark spots and neck stripes
short thick tail

species.name: Alligator
mustRead: broad rounded U-shaped snout with teeth hidden when the mouth shuts
armoured ridged scute rows down the back
thick tail longer than the body
species.note: Snout is wide and blunt; a crocodile's is narrow and V-shaped with the fourth tooth exposed.

species.name: Snapping Turtle
mustRead: massive hooked beak on an oversized head
long saw-toothed crested tail
rough ridged shell too small to withdraw into

species.name: Softshell Turtle
mustRead: flat leathery pancake shell with no scutes
tubular snorkel snout
broad fully webbed paddle feet

species.name: Cheetah
mustRead: black tear stripes running from eye to mouth
solid round spots (not rosettes)
small head on a deep narrow chest with a long thin tail
species.note: Body is greyhound-like: tall, whippet-thin waist, long legs; head is unusually small for a big cat.

species.name: Spotted Hyena
mustRead: back sloping sharply down from high shoulders to low hips
massive thick neck and heavy jaws
rounded ears and blotchy spots

species.name: African Wild Dog
mustRead: huge rounded bat-like ears
irregular patchwork blotches of black, tan and white
white brush tail tip on a lean long-legged frame

species.name: African Elephant
mustRead: long muscular trunk reaching the ground
enormous fan-shaped ears
curved tusks and pillar legs
species.note: Back dips in a saddle-shaped concave curve; the head is the highest point in Asian elephants but not here.

species.name: Wildebeest
mustRead: heavy boxy cow-like head with sideways-curving horns
shaggy chin beard and neck mane
high shoulders sloping to a slight rump

species.name: Hippopotamus
mustRead: enormous barrel body on stumpy pillar legs
huge squared muzzle wider than the skull
tiny ears, eyes and nostrils in a line on top of the head

species.name: Eland
mustRead: massive ox-like antelope body with a shoulder hump
straight tightly spiralled horns
dewlap of loose skin under the throat

species.name: Gazelle
mustRead: slender ringed lyre-curved horns
dark band along the flank between tan and white
fine delicate legs and long neck

species.name: Hartebeest
mustRead: extremely long narrow elongated face
back sloping steeply down to the hindquarters
bracket-shaped horns rising from a bony pedestal

species.name: Oryx
mustRead: very long straight rapier horns swept back
bold black facial mask and leg markings
blocky muscular horse-like body

species.name: Serval
mustRead: extraordinarily long legs for its body
very large upright oval ears on a small head
short tail and boldly spotted and barred coat
species.note: Legs are the longest of any cat relative to size; the body looks small slung between them.

species.name: Aardvark
mustRead: long tubular pig-like snout
tall rabbit-like ears
arched back and thick tapering kangaroo tail

species.name: Turtle
mustRead: domed shell covering the whole trunk
head and neck poking out the front
stumpy scaly legs
species.note: Generic name interpreted as a representative freshwater pond turtle. Commonly drawn with the shell as a separate hat sitting on the back; the shell IS the body wall, legs and neck emerge from under its rim.

species.name: Bison
mustRead: huge muscular shoulder hump
massive low-slung shaggy head with beard
narrow tapering hindquarters
species.note: The silhouette is front-heavy: the topline peaks at the shoulder hump and slopes steeply down to small hips. Often drawn as a uniform barrel like a cow.

species.name: Prairie Dog
mustRead: plump cylindrical body
very short stubby tail
small rounded ears flat to the head

species.name: Ground Squirrel
mustRead: long low tubular body
thin sparsely furred tail, not a bushy plume
tiny ears
species.note: Generic name read as a representative ground squirrel. Unlike a tree squirrel the tail is short and flat, not a big feathery arch.

species.name: Gopher
mustRead: cylindrical neckless body
huge protruding orange incisors outside the lips
oversized digging claws on the forefeet

species.name: Horned Lizard
mustRead: crown of backward-pointing horns on the rear of the skull
flat wide pancake-round body
fringe of pointed scales along the flanks
species.note: Body is a squat disc with a very short tail, not a normal long-tailed lizard shape.

species.name: Saiga
mustRead: bulbous drooping trunk-like nose
translucent ringed horns rising straight up
slim antelope legs
